description: Hum Sharma Tiffin Service chalate hain, Sector 62 Noida se. Ghar ka bana shudh shakahari khana, kam tel masala. Lunch 12:30 se 2 baje tak aur dinner 7:30 se 9 baje tak deliver karte hain, Sunday chhutti. Monthly tiffin ke liye ek din pehle batana hoga. Delivery Sector 58 se 63 tak free hai. WhatsApp 98110 45672.
